messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — billing shadow vs canonical fingerprint drift for customer shard EU-WEST-1 detected (window 2026-03-17T02:10Z–2026-03-17T03:40Z). Pager to #incidents.

oncall-engr-kate: ack. I'm on it, joining Zoom.

sara-billing: saw customer-reported spike in overage flags. Possible overreporting. Pulling counts.

miguel-sre: initial metric: shadow_ledger.tokens_count/primary_ledger.tokens_count = 1.12 at peak. Trend up from 1.02 90m ago.

alice-platform: queued live-recon job id=LR-8932. Starting prefix-replay against emitter-v2 fallback.

jack-support: prepping customer comms. which customers impacted? any high-dollar accounts?

sara-billing: list: acct-842, acct-1290, acct-2713 (top 3 by spend). Will attach sample diffs.

miguel-sre: small repro log:
```
2026-03-17T02:45:12Z emitter-v2 -> kafka-eu partition 4 offset 2345231 tokens=41234
2026-03-17T02:45:12Z shadow-processor acked but count=45900
```

oncall-engr-kate: looks like emitter duplication on commit path. Hypothesis: at-least-once writes with missing dedupe key after recent shard rebalance.

alice-platform: rolling emitter-v2 -> emitter-v2-safe (dedupe on commit) to eu-west-1 nodes. Canary to 2 hosts now.

sara-billing: support please hold outbound notifications until we confirm magnitude. If counts drop to <1.05 after canary, we send 'informational' email.

jack-support: copy. Draft ready, will stand by.

miguel-sre: mitigation progress: canary shows ratio back to 1.01 after 4 minutes. Running a full recon for 60m window.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation action emitter swap initiated by alice-platform at 2026-03-17T02:52Z. Noted.

sara-billing: reconciliation job produced preliminary delta: acct-842 +9.8%, acct-1290 +3.1%, acct-2713 +11.4% (shadow > canonical). These are visible in billing reports — risk of overflag.

billing-ops: recommend issuing credit hold for top 3 while we complete full replay. Suggest customers flagged but not billed until full reconciled.

jack-support: escalated to PMs + legal for top account acct-2713. Preparing notice.

miguel-sre: next steps: 1) continue replay to close window, 2) run dedupe pass on shadow ledger, 3) validate post-replay ratios <1.02.

oncall-engr-kate: ETA for full replay ~35m. I'll keep timeline updates.

jack-support: will send hold notice template in 20m unless counts still unstable.

sara-billing: customer impact classification: P2 (billing inconsistency, customer-facing overage flags). No confirmed charge yet. Keep P2.

alice-platform: confirm emitter rollback not needed; we used safe emitter with dedupe. No rollbacks.

miguel-sre: metrics trending: ratio now 1.03 and falling. Live trace shows duplicate commit path removed.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: incident annotated as 'mitigated' by miguel-sre at 2026-03-17T03:10Z. Keep thread for postmortem notes.

jack-support: sending interim customer note now to affected accounts; cc billing ops.

sara-billing: I'll file a billing hold & start refund pre-approval for acct-2713 in case final delta >10%.

oncall-engr-kate: adding blameless postmortem checklist items: emitter dedupe guardrail, canary expansion policy, reconciler alert thresholds.

alice-platform: will open PR for stronger commit keys and safer rebalance. Reference: GH#1248.

miguel-sre: leaving final status: mitigated, ongoing recon, customer-notified. Closing pager handoff to retrospective.

jack-support: thanks team :pray:
